title: QuickDesk
summary: A plain PHP/Apache helpdesk on MariaDB: SQL-injection auth bypass on the agent login, a nightly SQL dump left in the web root, and unsalted MD5 password hashes a report can crack and reuse.

loot.description: a nightly SQL dump served from the web root, leaking the unsalted MD5 password hashes

cmd: SELECT password FROM users WHERE username='admin'
loot.description: admin's unsalted MD5 hash (cracks to letmein123)
customer billing PII (name, email, phone, card last-4, MRR)
